Mia Chen: Quick pulse for Firefly onboarding — weekly health check. Focus: p95/p99 latency by route/model and streaming vs non-streaming. Saw a usage bump Wed night. Any regressions?
Samir Patel: Pushed a snapshot of the last 7d. Streaming denotes partial token streaming, non-streaming is full-response. Highlights below.
Samir Patel: ```
Route                Model        Mode         p95(ms)  p99(ms)  error_rate  qps
chat.complete        crimson-7b   streaming    420      980      0.9%        12
chat.complete        crimson-7b   non-stream   380      720      0.5%        8
embed.search         ember-1.2    non-stream   120      210      0.1%        25
rerank               ember-1.2    streaming    300      650      1.8%        4
```
CS Bot: Automated alert: chat.complete (crimson-7b, streaming) p99 +15% vs last week, anomaly detected Wed 03:20 UTC. Marked severity: medium.
Leo Martinez: Noted. Cost impact: streaming path increased token spend ~22% week-over-week due to more partials + a retry spike on Wed (~3% retries). Current projected monthly overrun ~ $1.2k if unchanged. :money_with_wings:
Mia Chen: Error rate on rerank streaming stands out (1.8%). Any known config changes?
Samir Patel: No intentional config changes from our side. Logs show a small cluster of timeout 504s tied to one GPU pod that restarted Wed 03:15. Could be batching + long seq combo.
Leo Martinez: For Firefly we had batching set to conservative low to keep latency down; looks like we need a short experiment: bump max_batch_ms by 5ms for streaming routes to avoid premature partial flushes. I can run a canary.
Mia Chen: Action items: 1) Samir -> check kernel selection + pod health for crimson-7b streaming (investigate restart cause). 2) Leo -> schedule 1-hr canary to increase max_batch_ms on chat.complete streaming and monitor p95/p99. 3) CS -> prep a ~2-sentence note for customer if we need to schedule brief rolling fix window.
Samir Patel: Owning #1. Will triage and post findings by EOD UTC. :white_check_mark:
Leo Martinez: Owning #2. Canary tomorrow 10:00 UTC, will post metrics. :rocket:
Mia Chen: I'll draft the customer note and hold until we have canary results. Renewal risk status: green for now but move to amber if p99 > 1s for next two checks.
CS Bot: Logged actions to ticket CS-4728 and set follow-up reminder for Friday.
Samir Patel: Quick note — embed.search non-stream numbers stable, no action there.
Mia Chen: Thanks team. Short sync Friday after canary to decide next steps.
